title: Add known decision reason-code primitive
outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive DecisionReasonCode enum for the 11 reason-code examples currently documented by the typed decision model, without claiming an exhaustive policy vocabulary or defining text/wire encoding, DecisionEnvelope construction, authority, thresholds, persistence, or side effects.
rationale: P1 requires a typed DecisionEnvelope with machine-consumable reason_codes. The typed decision model already documents 11 stable reason-code examples while explicitly keeping exact serialized schema refinement in P1/P4. This Grain captures only those currently documented semantic labels as future-extensible in-memory values so later DecisionEnvelope work can reference typed known reasons without inventing parsing, serialization, policy authority, or a claim that the vocabulary is complete.
scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive DecisionReasonCode with exactly the 11 currently documented reason-code examples as known in-memory variants: ExactDuplicate, NewerSource, ValidTimeChanged, SourceConflict, LowSourceAuthority, CrossScopeConflict, StaleSource, ExplicitUserOperation, InsufficientEvidence, AmbiguousEntity, and PolicyReviewRequired.
Treat the variants as descriptive decision-analysis evidence only; a reason code never grants authorization, target selection, mutation authority, threshold bypass, execution, or side effects.
Derive Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash and add focused standard-library-only tests proving all 11 known values are distinct and copy/hash value semantics hold.
Keep the type future-extensible while leaving textual/numeric/wire encoding and any exhaustive policy vocabulary to later dedicated Grains.
scope_out: Any claim that the 11 documented examples are the complete future reason-code vocabulary, or any guarantee about ordering, numeric discriminants, stable textual spelling, Display/FromStr parsing, serde, wire encoding, persistence, schema field names, migrations, API, or MCP.

DecisionEnvelope construction, candidate references, action scores, confidence, abstention behavior, evidence references, relevant memory versions, engine identity, policy revision binding, replay semantics, or threshold behavior.
Authorization, target selection, policy evaluation, mutation execution, side effects, FORGET/REDACT behavior, or parsing free-form model prose into authority.
Any third-party runtime, build, dev, or test dependency.
acceptance: The exact implementation changes only crates/morize-core/src/decision.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.
morize-core publicly exports DecisionReasonCode alongside MemoryAction and MemoryActionSetVersion without changing either existing type.

DecisionReasonCode is a non-exhaustive in-memory enum with exactly the 11 currently documented known variants: ExactDuplicate, NewerSource, ValidTimeChanged, SourceConflict, LowSourceAuthority, CrossScopeConflict, StaleSource, ExplicitUserOperation, InsufficientEvidence, AmbiguousEntity, and PolicyReviewRequired.
The implementation and documentation explicitly avoid claiming that those 11 known variants exhaust all future reason codes.
A DecisionReasonCode grants no authorization, target selection, threshold override, policy decision, mutation authority, execution, side effect, or storage behavior.
DecisionReasonCode supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests prove all 11 known variants are distinct and preserve copy/hash value semantics without defining ordering.

The implementation defines no stable textual/numeric representation, Display/FromStr parser, serialization, wire/persistence encoding, DecisionEnvelope, confidence, abstention policy, evidence binding, engine identity, policy revision binding, replay semantics, API, MCP, or domain-record integration.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and executes the focused decision-reason-code tests.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain adds no runtime, build, dev, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for fidelity to the currently documented 11 reason examples, non-exhaustive future extensibility, absence of textual/wire/authority semantics, scope containment, prerequisite identity, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite SG-000026 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000027 decision-reason-code implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data has been written by this Grain.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free in-memory DecisionReasonCode enum in the existing decision module, focused tests, and morize-core re-export. The enum represents only the 11 currently documented known reason examples and remains non-exhaustive. No text/numeric/wire encoding, DecisionEnvelope, authority, execution, policy, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head for fidelity to the 11 currently documented known reason examples, non-exhaustive future extensibility, absence of textual/numeric/wire and authority semantics, exact prerequisite identity, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the SG-000027 decision-reason-code implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: The typed DecisionEnvelope already requires machine-consumable reason_codes, while the repository currently documents 11 reason examples but does not freeze an exhaustive or serialized vocabulary. A non-exhaustive in-memory enum for only those known examples is the smallest safe typed increment: it avoids free-form strings in later envelope code without inventing textual encoding, parser behavior, policy authority, thresholds, or persistence.

requirements: Reason codes are descriptive evidence only and must never grant authorization or cause durable side effects by themselves.
The implementation must not reinterpret the documentation's examples as an exhaustive future policy vocabulary or freeze their textual/wire representation.
